correctness.rationale: Independent reconstruction of all 2^(2n+1) vertex masks for n=3,4,5,6 agrees with packaged face counts (including empty) (18,42),(47,103),(103,313),(254,866). Deterministic relative toggle matching gives 12,28,105 collapse pairs and no unmatched n≤5 faces; every free-face removal is directly checkable. At n6 relative 612 cells reduce by 301 unit-pivot algebraic Morse cancellations to 7 critical 3-cells, 2 critical 4-cells and one 5-cell, with ∂4 columns (0,0,1,1,0,−1,0) and ∂5=(1,−1). Primitive ∂4 image and ker∂4=im∂5 imply torsion-free H3=Z^6 and all other relative homology zero. The independently constructed exact-integer reduction reproduced critical masks and matrices. No inference about n≥7 or absolute L6 homotopy is made.
